# BuyMailSupply

BuyMailSupply is a China sourcing agent and procurement agency based in Yiwu, Zhejiang Province, China — the world's largest wholesale market. The company helps businesses worldwide source products from verified Chinese manufacturers and acts as the client's local partner on the ground in China.

## What the company does
- Sources daily essentials, household items, packaging supplies, office products, apparel & fashion, beauty & personal care, electronics, toys, and promotional gifts from Chinese factories.
- Services: supplier search and verification, factory inspection, quality control, sample coordination, price negotiation, freight forwarding, export documentation, customs clearance, and RMB/Ruble settlement.
- Works with OEM/ODM and private labeling / custom branding projects.
- Communicates in English and Russian; serves clients in the UK, Europe, Russia, CIS, North America, Australia, and the Middle East.
